delta.note: Pasal 31 ayat (1) (tax withheld from the employee's income) is read as the gross withholding method, which takes effect from January 2023 because no regulation fixes the method; the annualised PPh 21 method (fixed factor 12, annual job expense cap, irregular income taxed as the annual difference, computed self-contained) and the 0,89% JKK rate are company rules for 1 January 2023 to 31 December 2024 that yield to mandatory regulation and report a conflict where it computes differently.

output.reason: The company payroll regulation sets how PPh 21 is computed for its employees during 2023-2024: employer-paid JKK (0.89%), JKM (0.30%) and company health contribution (4%) are added to gross income; employee JHT (2%) and JP (1%) are deducted; monthly PPh 21 for January-November is computed by annualizing regular gross income, deducting biaya jabatan (5%, max Rp6,000,000 a year), JHT/JP and PTKP, rounding PKP down to full thousands, applying Article 17(1)(a) rates and dividing by 12; irregular income (annual bonus paid in March, THR) is taxed as the difference in annual tax; December or the last month settles the annual tax. These are value, rate, rounding and calculation-step rules for permanent employees.
